theme: 教材片語・中高階 750–850 第 22 群

items.colloc: bring to an end 使結束 | come to an abrupt end 突然結束
items.distinct: finish 完成工作 | terminate 終止契約
ex: The meeting will come to an end by five.
會議將在五點前結束。
Their contract will come to an end next month.
他們的合約下個月即將到期。
Our partnership has come to an end recently.
我們的合作關係近期已經結束。

items.pos: phr. 想出（主意、計畫）；提出
items.colloc: come up with a solution 想出解決方案 | come up with an idea 提出想法
items.distinct: think of 想起；考慮 | propose 提議
ex: She came up with a creative marketing strategy.
她提出了一項創意的行銷策略。
Can you come up with a better plan?
你能想出一個更好的方案嗎？
The team came up with many innovative ideas.
團隊提出了許多創新點子。

items.pos: n. 商業關係；貿易往來
items.colloc: establish commercial relations 建立商業關係 | maintain commercial relations 維持商業往來
items.distinct: public relations 公關 | international relations 國際關係
ex: The two countries have strong commercial relations.
兩國之間有緊密的商業往來。
They seek to improve commercial relations abroad.
他們致力於改善國外的商業關係。
Maintaining commercial relations is vital for growth.
維持商業關係對成長至關重要。

items.colloc: high commercial value 高商業價值 | prove its commercial value 證明其商業價值
items.distinct: market value 市場價值 | resale value 轉售價值
ex: This invention has significant commercial value.
這項發明具有顯著的商業價值。
The project lacks long-term commercial value.
該專案缺乏長期的商業價值。
Investors evaluate the commercial value of ideas.
投資者評估點子的商業價值。

items.colloc: avoid conflict of interest 避免利益衝突 | potential conflict of interest 潛在利益衝突
items.distinct: clash of opinion 意見不合 | dispute 爭議
ex: He resigned to avoid a conflict of interest.
他為了避免利益衝突而辭職。
The policy prevents any conflict of interest.
該政策防止任何利益衝突發生。
Please disclose any potential conflict of interest.
請揭露任何潛在的利益衝突。

items.colloc: miss a connecting flight 錯過轉機航班 | book a connecting flight 預訂轉機航班
items.distinct: direct flight 直飛航班 | non-stop flight 不經停航班
ex: I have a connecting flight in Singapore.
我在新加坡有轉機航班。
The connecting flight leaves in two hours.
轉機航班將在兩小時後起飛。
We missed our connecting flight due to delays.
我們因延誤錯過了轉機航班。

items.colloc: be content with the results 對結果滿意 | be content with less 甘於現狀
items.distinct: satisfied with 對…感到滿足 | happy with 對…感到開心
ex: Are you content with your current salary?
你對目前的薪資感到滿意嗎？
She is content with her professional progress.
她對自己的職業進展感到滿意。
We should not be content with mediocrity.
我們不應滿足於平庸。

items.pos: n. 文案編輯；校對人員
items.colloc: hire a copy editor 聘請校對 | work as a copy editor 擔任校對
items.distinct: editor 編輯 | proofreader 校對員
ex: The copy editor checked the final report.
文案編輯檢查了最終報告。
Every article needs a professional copy editor.
每一篇文章都需要專業的文案編輯。
She works as a freelance copy editor.
她擔任自由接案的文案編輯。

items.pos: adj. 具成本效益的；划算的
items.colloc: highly cost effective 高成本效益 | cost effective solution 具效益的解決方案
items.distinct: economical 經濟的 | profitable 有利可圖的
ex: This strategy is more cost effective now.
這項策略現在更具成本效益。
We need a cost effective training program.
我們需要一套具成本效益的培訓計畫。
Solar power is becoming quite cost effective.
太陽能正變得相當具成本效益。

items.colloc: write a cover letter 撰寫求職信 | attach a cover letter 附上求職信
items.distinct: resume 履歷表 | personal statement 自傳
ex: Please submit your resume and cover letter.
請提交您的履歷與求職信。
A strong cover letter helps get interviews.
強而有力的求職信有助於獲得面試。
She spent hours drafting her cover letter.
她花了數小時草擬求職信。

items.colloc: exceed credit limit 超過信用額度 | increase credit limit 提高信用額度
items.distinct: debit limit 簽帳限額 | balance 餘額
ex: Your credit limit has been increased today.
您的信用額度已於今日提高。
He reached his monthly credit limit quickly.
他很快就達到了每月信用額度。
Check your credit limit before you shop.
購物前請檢查您的信用額度。

items.colloc: date back to the 1990s 追溯至九零年代 | date back to ancient times 追溯至古代
items.distinct: originate from 起源於 | go back to 回溯到
ex: This custom dates back to the century.
這項習俗可追溯至該世紀。
The company dates back to fifty years ago.
這家公司始於五十年前。
Our business relations date back to 2005.
我們的商業關係可追溯至2005年。

items.colloc: deep and thorough analysis 深入詳盡的分析 | deep and meaningful conversation 有深度的對話
items.distinct: profound 深奧的 | extensive 廣泛的
ex: They conducted a deep and detailed review.
他們進行了一項深入且詳盡的審查。
The project requires a deep and clear vision.
該專案需要深入且清晰的願景。
A deep and honest discussion is needed.
我們需要一場深入且誠懇的討論。

items.pos: v. 引導流量；指揮交通
items.colloc: direct traffic to the site 將流量導向網站 | direct traffic manually 手動指揮交通
items.distinct: divert traffic 分流 | monitor traffic 監控流量
ex: Our ads direct traffic to the homepage.
我們的廣告將流量引導至首頁。
The software helps direct traffic efficiently.
該軟體有助於有效地引導流量。
Officers were sent to direct traffic nearby.
警官被派往附近指揮交通。

items.colloc: pay a down payment 支付頭期款 | require a down payment 要求支付預付金
items.distinct: installment 分期付款 | deposit 定金
ex: You must pay a down payment now.
你現在必須支付一筆頭期款。
She saved money for a down payment.
她存錢支付房屋頭期款。
The down payment is twenty percent total.
頭期款總共是百分之二十。

items.pos: phr. 在…設立底線；拒絕做…
items.colloc: draw the line at cheating 在作弊上設立底線 | draw the line at overtime 拒絕加班
items.distinct: set a limit 設定限制 | refuse to do 拒絕做
ex: I draw the line at working weekends.
我拒絕在週末上班。
He draws the line at dishonest practices.
他對於不誠實的行為會畫下底線。
We must draw the line at these demands.
我們必須對這些要求畫下底線。

items.pos: v. 順道放下；下降；減少
items.colloc: drop off a package 放下包裹 | sales drop off 銷售下滑
items.distinct: pick up 接人；撿起 | decline 衰退
ex: Please drop off the file at reception.
請把檔案放在接待處。
Sales began to drop off this quarter.
本季銷售額開始下滑。
Can you drop off the kids at school?
你能順道送孩子去學校嗎？

items.pos: phr. 重新啟用；清理；拿出（舊東西）
items.colloc: dust off an old plan 重新啟用舊計畫 | dust off the equipment 清理設備
items.distinct: revisit 重溫 | reactivate 重新啟動
ex: We decided to dust off the old project.
我們決定重新啟用那個舊專案。
It is time to dust off your skills.
是時候重新磨練你的技能了。
She dusted off her resume for the job.
她為了這份工作重新整理了履歷。

items.pos: phr. 吃光；耗盡（資源、時間）
items.colloc: eat up the budget 耗盡預算 | eat up time 浪費時間
items.distinct: consume 消耗 | use up 用完
ex: These repairs will eat up our budget.
這些維修費用會耗盡我們的預算。
Inefficient meetings eat up productive hours.
低效率的會議會耗盡工作時間。
Don't let errors eat up your profit.
別讓錯誤消耗掉你的利潤。

items.colloc: enter a design contest 參加設計比賽 | sign up to enter a contest 報名參加比賽
items.distinct: participate in 加入 | compete in 競爭
ex: Our team will enter a contest today.
我們團隊今天要參加一場比賽。
He decided to enter a contest online.
他決定在線上參加一場比賽。
Many people enter a contest for prizes.
許多人為了獎品而參加比賽。
